task_completion.description: Create a new tiddler with the title 'Incident Response Runbook'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The TiddlyWiki editor or a saved tiddler view showing the title 'Incident Response Runbook'.

task_completion.description: Add the tags 'Runbook' and 'Operations' to the tiddler.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tags 'Runbook' and 'Operations' visible in the tiddler's tag area (either in edit or view mode).

task_completion.description: Add a custom field named 'priority' with the value 'critical'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The fields section at the bottom of the tiddler editor showing a name 'priority' and value 'critical'.

task_completion.description: Include an introductory paragraph explaining the purpose of the runbook.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text at the beginning of the tiddler body that is not a transclusion or header, describing the runbook's purpose.

task_completion.description: Use at least three section headers to organize the content.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least three lines of text formatted as headers (e.g., starting with '!' in TiddlyWiki syntax) within the tiddler body.

task_completion.description: Include the four required transclusions in the correct order: Service Health Check Procedure, Database Failover Steps, Notification Escalation Matrix, and Post-Incident Review Template.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tiddler body containing the strings {{Service Health Check Procedure}}, {{Database Failover Steps}}, {{Notification Escalation Matrix}}, and {{Post-Incident Review Template}} in that specific sequence.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki web interface rather than just executing shell scripts to modify the underlying files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with the TiddlyWiki 'plus' button, text areas, and 'save' checkmark.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply overwrite the entire wiki state with a pre-made file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Step-by-step progress showing the 'Incident Response Runbook' being typed or composed in the browser.

integrity.description: The agent used TiddlyWiki transclusion syntax (double curly braces) rather than copy-pasting the text of the procedures.
integrity.visual_evidence: The editor view showing '{{Tiddler Name}}' syntax instead of the full text of the sub-procedures.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target tiddler must be titled 'Incident Response Runbook'. It must have tags ['Runbook', 'Operations'] and a custom field 'priority' set to 'critical'. The body must contain an intro, at least 3 headers, and the following transclusions in order: {{Service Health Check Procedure}}, {{Database Failover Steps}}, {{Notification Escalation Matrix}}, and {{Post-Incident Review Template}}.
